name: claude-viz

commands.title: Claude Viz: Turn Phone Access On/Off

claudeViz.notifyOnFinish.description: Show a notification when a Claude Code session finishes its turn.

claudeViz.sound.description: Play a sound when a Claude Code session needs your permission or input.

claudeViz.contextWindow.description: Context window, in tokens, the context gauge measures against.

claudeViz.diskWarnGb.description: Warn when free disk space drops below this many GB (red below two thirds of it).

claudeViz.celebrate.description: Briefly celebrate real outcomes: a commit landing, tests going green again, a subagent finishing cleanly, an achievement.

claudeViz.budget.dailyUsd.description: Daily budget in USD at API prices (0 = off). Warns at 80% and 100%.

claudeViz.budget.monthlyUsd.description: Monthly budget in USD at API prices (0 = off). Warns at 80% and 100%.

claudeViz.phone.port.description: Port for phone access (HTTPS on your Wi-Fi address only).

claudeViz.phone.autoOffHours.description: Phone access turns itself off after this many hours.

description: Live view of running Claude Code sessions and subagents: costs, limits, insights, history and a read-only phone page.
